description:

commits_data.title: Qt: Provide Carto basemap API key entry
commits_data.message:
Qt: Provide Carto basemap API key entry

Create a name resolution related preference to allow entry of a Carto
basemap API key entry. When set, the API key is put into the processed
HTML file used to show the endpoint map.

Fixes #21578
